items.reason: A gentle, non-active cleanser suits very dry-feeling skin without adding to dryness.
A rich ceramide and glycerin cream supports the low moisture score and keeps skin feeling comfortable.
A mineral SPF 50 gives daily sun protection, which matters for skin that may feel more sensitive.

response.routine_note: The facial wax strips have been removed because waxing pulls on the skin surface, and skin that is on isotretinoin can be very fragile and easily damaged; please ask your prescriber or dermatologist about safe options for upper lip hair. Cleanse gently, moisturize morning and night, and apply the mineral sunscreen every morning.}</br>
